critical_code_review_comments: server.py:180 /api/geocode — no rate limiting, external Nominatim requires ≤1 req/s per usage policy. Currently OK for MVP but consider caching identical queries (dict cache) and adding a from-cache short-circuit. Not a bug.

server.py:198-200 float(data[0]['lat']) assumes Nominatim response shape; wrapped in outer try/except returning 502 only for network errors. If Nominatim returns malformed JSON without expected keys the request would raise KeyError → uncaught 500. Minor hardening: wrap in try/except (KeyError, ValueError). Non-blocking.

MapApp.js:181 withinRadius uses p.distance (backend-computed only when lat/lng passed to /points). Verified working — when userLoc is set, fetchPoints re-runs with lat/lng and returns distance for every point. Good.

MapApp.js:187 listPoints slice(0,300) — nearby tab still slices to 300 even though visiblePoints is already radius-filtered. At radius=200 (943 pts) UI only shows first 300 cards; user cannot scroll past. Consider raising cap for nearby tab, or dropping the truncation-note (currently hidden for nearby). Minor UX.

server.py:181 async def geocode uses synchronous `requests.get` — blocks the event loop for up to 10s. Should be httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor. Under load could stall the API. Actionable improvement.

MapApp.js:406 nearby-address form submits via <button type='submit'> without action feedback on network failure — currently caught by try/catch showing 'Impossible de localiser cette adresse' — acceptable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: NEW 'Près de moi' feature is COMPLETE. Numbers observed at Paris (48.8566, 2.3522): radius=5km → 210 points, 20km → 434, 200km → 943. Ouessant (remote Atlantic island) at 5km → 0 (nearby-empty shown). To interact with the HTML5 range slider from Playwright, direct .value= dispatch doesn't fire React onChange — MUST use native input value setter trick: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,val) then dispatch 'input'+'change'. Panel is still duplicated (desktop aside + mobile sheet) → scope selectors to 'aside'. Geolocation must be granted BEFORE page.goto via context.grant_permissions+set_geolocation. Nominatim (external) responds in ~500-1500ms; give addresses 3s wait. Regression numbers: total=3193, relais=2220, lockers=973, Lyon=93, Nîmes(nimes)=21, Marseille=131, 69001=57.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs. Only observation: /api/geocode uses blocking requests.get inside async endpoint (see code review); acceptable for MVP but worth converting to httpx async for scale.
